3.1.1.value: A girl who lights the lamps of a drowning city has one night left before the lamps go electric — and every lamp she lit holds someone's memory.

3.2.1.value: On the last night of the gas lamps, Vessmoor's youngest lamplighter must ferry the city's stored memories across the Hollow River before the Brightglass Company snuffs them for good.

3.3.1.value: In Vessmoor, every street lamp lit by a Guild lamplighter keeps a sliver of memory from the people who pass beneath it. When the Brightglass Company wins the contract to replace the lamps with electric glass, seventeen-year-old Odile Marsh learns the memories will die with the flames. With an old ferryman, her stubborn little brother and a lantern that should have gone out years ago, she has one night to carry the light to Lantern Isle — and to decide which memories are worth the price of her own.
